info.title: Ninety.io Universal API
info.description: Access Ninety issues, to-dos, teams, scorecard measurables, rocks, and milestones through the Ninety Public API.

post.description: Creates a new rock in Ninety.io.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

teamId.description: The Id of the team the Rock belongs to

dueDate.description: The due date of the Rock (ISO 8601)

statusCode.description: The status of the Rock: OFF_TRACK, ON_TRACK, DONE, or CANCELED

levelCode.description: The level of the Rock: USER, COMPANY_AND_DEPARTMENT, COMPANY, or DEPARTMENT

quarter.description: The quarter associated with the Rock: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, or None

description.example: Redesign the onboarding wizard to reduce drop-off by 20%

futureScope.description: The future scope of the Rock: Current, Next, Later, or Future

rockQuarterYearDueDate.description: The quarter-aligned year due date of the Rock (ISO 8601)

addCreatorToFollowersList.description: When true, the authenticated user is added to the Rock's followers list
